name: date-range-picker
title: Date range picker
description: A button that opens a range calendar and two typed date fields.
a11y: The trigger is a button naming the field and the current range; it opens a dialog with two text fields and the calendar.
Typed fields are labelled Start and End, accept YYYY-MM-DD, apply on Enter or blur and mark aria-invalid with an alert message when the text is not a pickable date.
Choosing the end date closes the dialog and returns focus to the trigger; Escape closes without changing.
All range-calendar keyboard behaviour applies inside.
